mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulated_trade (stock_id, buy_date, buy_price, shares) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{buyDate}, #{buyPrice}, #{shares})
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_id, buy_date, buy_price, shares, created_at, updated_at FROM simulated_trade ORDER BY buy_date DESC, stock_id ASC

SELECT trade_id, trade_date, high_price FROM ( SELECT st.id AS trade_id, p.trade_date, p.high_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY st.id ORDER BY p.high_price DESC, p.trade_date ASC) AS rn FROM simulated_trade st JOIN stock_daily_price p ON p.stock_id = st.stock_id AND p.trade_date BETWEEN st.buy_date AND #{settleDate} AND p.high_price > 0 ) ranked WHERE rn = 1
